name: Flora
source:
A noble princess and knight who will devote herself to the prince to save her kingdom. Flora had always admired the powerful knights who protected her country from the many monsters that roamed the land. Being the second princess and having a younger brother who will one day take the throne, the king had allowed Flora to take up the sword and become a knight, as she had always dreamed. To Flora, it is her job as a part of the royal family to fight and defend her people. Thus, to save her kingdom, she decides to marry the prince and move away from her beloved homeland.
